differences: Changing an earlier ESI answer clears the later answers that no longer apply, so a hidden decision is never sent; the source kept and sent them (the server ignores them once an earlier decision decides the level).
The worklist sorts by wait, longest first, in the browser; the source relied on the server order.
The ESI level chip uses semantic theme colours (danger, warning, success, info) instead of the source's esi1–esi5 palette.
